one_line: Indian-American astrophysicist who discovered the Chandrasekhar limit for white dwarf stars.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, slim, slightly bookish build with calm, controlled posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed thin moustache, thoughtful dark eyes under slightly arched brows; default expression is composed and introspective, with a subtle analytical focus.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair parted on the left, sides slightly tapered; no visible scalp, always tidy; no headwear, emphasizing a disciplined academic look.
appearance.costume: 1930s-early 1940s formal academic attire: a well-fitted dark charcoal-grey single-breasted wool suit jacket with modest lapels over a crisp white cotton dress shirt, simple dark navy tie with a tiny repeating diagonal stripe pattern in lighter blue, matching charcoal-grey wool trousers with clean crease, brown leather lace-up Oxford shoes, and a thin silver wristwatch on his left wrist; in colder scenes a light brown tweed vest is visible under the jacket but the default is jacket closed, vest suggested by subtle bulk at the torso.
appearance.signature: A worn, dark-brown leather-bound notebook held in his left hand, open to sketched equations and a small spiral galaxy diagram, with a simple graphite pencil resting across the pages.

ref_desc: Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar is a slim late-20s man with medium-brown skin, short parted black hair, thin moustache, charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, navy striped tie, brown Oxfords, silver wristwatch, and a worn brown notebook of equations and galaxies.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar as a slim late-20s Indian astrophysicist with medium-brown skin, an oval face, thoughtful dark eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed thin moustache, his short black hair combed with a left side part. He wears era-accurate 1930s formal academic clothing: a dark charcoal-grey single-breasted wool suit jacket over a crisp white dress shirt, a simple navy blue tie with tiny lighter-blue diagonal stripes, matching charcoal-grey wool trousers with a sharp crease, brown leather lace-up Oxford shoes, and a thin silver wristwatch on his left wrist, with a subtle suggestion of a light brown tweed vest under the jacket. Show him holding his signature worn dark-brown leather-bound notebook in his left hand, open to sketched equations and a small spiral galaxy diagram, with a pencil resting across the pages, and clearly present his consistent colour palette of charcoal grey, white, navy blue, and brown in a clean studio-style pose for use across many panels.
